question: Read all data from the file "all data.xlsx", determine the continent for each record based on the "Customer Country/Region" field (mapping rule: match each country/region name to one of the six continents — Europe / Asia / North America / South America / Africa / Oceania; any entry that cannot be matched is classified as "Unlabeled"). Spelling errors and abbreviations should be matched accordingly. Group by continent and compute the sum of the "RMB Subtotal" and "USD Subtotal" fields. Output a summary table with 3 columns: the 1st column is "Continent", the 2nd column is "Total RMB Subtotal", and the 3rd column is "Total USD Subtotal". Monetary values should be rounded to 2 decimal places. Sort in descending order by "Total RMB Subtotal". Only output continents that have data (i.e., at least one record); continents with no data should not be displayed.
